summary: The local model reported no defects, which matches my own cold read — the outcome object is consistent across all five reasons, every call site was migrated, the interceptor's behaviour is genuinely unchanged because each outcome returns exactly what is in localStorage, and the new specs' mocks and banner assertions (including apostrophe characters and the stubbed v-alert `text` attribute) line up with the real code — but its triage wrongly calls `money` untouched for a change whose whole purpose is keeping test messages off the owner's quota.
